posts.post:
the most expensive piece in your closet is almost always the one you wear the least. 

we buy things for a version of our life that doesn't exist yet.

ironing a t-shirt before leaving the house. 

necessary ritual or a complete waste of time?

we just scrapped an entire production run because the shade of charcoal was slightly too blue under direct sunlight. 

the factory owner thinks i’m insane.

nothing worse than a pair of trousers that looks perfect standing up but ruins your posture the moment you sit down. 

fit matters more than aesthetics.
